ov.title: 第四节：往里打，还是不进

ov.text: 尼克斯全场第一次领先
第四节第 2 次犯规 · 不用罚球
尼克斯全场只领先了 53.8 秒

chunks.zh: 当然，我会更注意一点，
chunks.en: Of course I'm going to be more — I mean, I'm going to be more careful,

chunks.zh: 但不会有太大改变。
chunks.en: but it's not going to change much.

chunks.zh: 我就批评这一点，老兄，你们根本投不进啊
chunks.en: That's my criticism. Like, damn, dude, you ain't making them.

chunks.zh: 领先 20 分，根本没理由连着投八九个三分
chunks.en: There's never a reason to shoot eight or nine in a row when you got a 20-point lead.

chunks.zh: 防守上，我们就是做得更狠、坚持得更久，
chunks.en: Defensively, we just did it harder for longer stretches,

chunks.zh: 上半场拿76分靠的那套东西，我们丢了，
chunks.en: We got away from what got us the 76 points in the first half,

chunks.zh: 我当时在想什么？
chunks.en: What was going through my mind?

chunks.zh: 跟平时一样，就是一次投篮而已。
chunks.en: I mean, same thing as always, it's just a shot.

chunks.zh: 可能他是想突破，
chunks.en: Maybe he was going to drive

chunks.zh: 想一直运着球，把时间耗完。
chunks.en: and wanted to keep the dribble to run out the clock.

chunks.zh: 我不知道，你们得去问他。
chunks.en: I don't know. You would have to ask him.

chunks.zh: 没怎么看清，我也说不好。
chunks.en: I couldn't really see. I don't know.

chunks.zh: 就只看到那记封盖。
chunks.en: I just saw the block.

chunks.zh: 我跟阿努诺比说，你块头这么大、这么壮、运动能力这么好，
chunks.en: I told OG, as big, as strong, as athletic as he is,

chunks.zh: 今晚的前场篮板，你得给我抢疯了。
chunks.en: he's got to be a monster on the offensive glass tonight.

chunks.zh: 我现在在想什么？
chunks.en: What's going through my mind right now?

chunks.zh: 我觉得接下来只有两条路。
chunks.en: I think it's going to go one of two ways.

chunks.zh: 两条路，一条坏的，一条好的。
chunks.en: One of two ways, and a bad one and a good one.

chunks.zh: 坏的那条，是就此放弃；
chunks.en: And I know the bad one would be giving up,

chunks.zh: 好的那条，是经历这一场，变得更强、更抱团。
chunks.en: the good one would be getting stronger through this, getting more together.

chunks.zh: 我知道，我们会走好的那条路。
chunks.en: And I know this is what we're going to do.
